title: Schrödinger's 1926 wave equation paper
summary: The first 1926 'Quantisierung als Eigenwertproblem' paper is a founding paper of wave mechanics.
body: Erwin Schrödinger published "Quantisierung als Eigenwertproblem" in Annalen der Physik in 1926. It is a founding paper of wave mechanics. The v1 line "1925–1926: Heisenberg and Schrödinger develop quantum mechanics" is a fair label for this period if it is read as a historical summary, not as a claim that one paper finished the subject. Matrix mechanics and wave mechanics were shown to be related; that equivalence is a further result, not this card.
